state_profile.voting_summary: Missouri added two weeks of no-excuse in-person absentee voting in 2022, alongside excuse-required mail; results are reported as combined totals without a method breakdown. Polls close at 8 p.m. Eastern; absentee votes are counted first and released shortly after closing, then election day precincts report, with the state near-complete by early morning. Kansas City and St. Louis totals landing late in the evening give the count a modest blue tail.
